correctness.rationale: Exact update on special bits u,v, number t among a−2 ordinary first-shore bits and k among b opposite-shore bits is determined by M(k+v,b+1,u),M(k+u,b+1,v), the b-neighbor majority for t, and a-neighbor majority for k using S=t+u+v. Since any block either retains every bit or becomes uniform, this is an exact labelled-state reduction. Recurrent mixed B must remain mixed and have S=a/2; even b forces k=b/2 and swaps the special bits while fixing ordinary bits, yielding the binomial fixed/cycle formulas; odd b forces AND/OR and only a=4 gives new fixed states. Uniform B recurrence gives two consensus fixed states plus one opposite-shore two-cycle. Independent direct labelled-vertex checker and independent weighted signature checker code inspected; separately reran representative exact direct enumerations. Stirling yields T_{2m,2m}∼16^m/(4πm).

value.rationale: Minimal symmetry-breaking of a standard complete bipartite majority network yields a natural two-parameter infinite family, with a structural dichotomy: exponentially many balanced equilibria pair into oscillations for even-even shores, while an exceptional size-four shore creates equilibria for odd opposite size. This complete parameter-sensitive dynamical response is not a textbook consequence of knowing periods are at most two.

final_claim: For a,b≥3, one additional edge inside the a-shore of K_{a,b} creates precisely the stated parity-dependent fixed-point and primitive two-cycle counts under synchronous tie-retaining majority; in even-even sizes it converts 2T fixed states to T new primitive cycles without changing recurrent-state total.
